data.long_meaning: Derived from Old English 'bréan', meaning 'to shout' or 'to burn'. In Celtic, 'brend' means 'sworn', making Brenda a powerful and fiery name for a Christian girl. The name Brenda carries the meaning “Intender, Sworn One” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Brenda usually hope their child will grow to embody intender, sworn one and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolic of dedication, loyalty, and passion for one's faith.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Brenda total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_hebrew.name: ברנדה
in_hebrew.meaning: משמעות שם זה: נקבה, חזק, סמל, עם
in_hebrew.long_meaning: שם יהדות עתיק: 'בר-נדה' - נקבה, חזקה, סמלית. 'בר' - בנו של, 'נדה' - חזקה. בעקבות הכנסייה הקתולית, 'ברנדה' הפכה לשם נשים נפוץ, עם משמעות של תכונות הטובות - חזק, אומנות, ענווה, נכונות, סבלנות, וכבוד. ישנם 13 שמות הקשורים ל'ברנדה' בלטינית. שם זה נמצא 2 פעמים במקרא. שם זה נמצא בקהילות יהודיות ואתניות. שם זה נמצא בקהילות נוצריות.

in_greek.name: Μπρέντα
in_greek.meaning: σημασία ονόματος: θηλυκό, ισχυρό, σύμβολο, μεν
in_greek.long_meaning: παλαιόχριστιανικό όνομα: 'Μπρέντα' - θηλυκό, ισχυρό, σύμβολο. 'Μπρέν' - γιος του, 'Ντά' - ισχυρό. Η εκκλησία της Ρωμαιοκαθολικής, 'Μπρέντα' έγινε δημοφιλές γυναικείο όνομα, με σημασία που περιλαμβάνει τις καλές ιδιότητες: ισχυρό, τέχνη, ταπείνωση, αλήθεια, υπομονή, και σεβασμό. Υπάρχουν 13 ονόματα που σχετίζονται με το 'Μπρέντα' στο Λατινικό. Το όνομα αυτό συναντάται 2 φορές στο Βιβλίο. Το όνομα αυτό υπάρχει στις κοινότητες των Εβραίων και των εθνοτικών. Το όνομα αυτό υπάρχει στις κοινότητες των Χριστιανών.

in_latin.name: Brenda
in_latin.long_meaning: nomen Christianum antiquum: 'Brenda' - nomen femininum fortis, sympholon. 'Bren' - filius, 'Dah' - fortis. data.cultural_impact: The name Brenda was popular among the Celts, and it was traditionally given to girls born into warrior or noble families. In Christian circles, the name represented bravery, strength, and resilience in the face of adversity. Brenda was a name that inspired courage and determination, making it a favorite among strong Christian women.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Brenda carries deep spiritual significance for Christians. It signifies a commitment to the faith and a willingness to stand strong in the face of opposition or hardship. The name 'Brenda' reminds us of the boldness and tenacity of the early Christian martyrs who refused to renounce their faith even in the face of death. It also reminds us of the power of faith and the importance of remaining steadfast in our belief in God. Ultimately, the name Brenda is a powerful reminder of the power of the Christian spirit to overcome any challenge or obstacle.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Brenda: Brighid's friend or raven-knight. Named after the Celtic goddess Brighid, symbolizing creativity, healing, and wisdom, with the strength and mystery of a raven companion.
